description: A pod affinity term: which pods to be close to or away from, and the topology domain that is compared.

namespaces.description: Namespaces the term matches. Defaults to the namespace of the pod when unset.

namespaceSelector.description: Namespaces the term matches, by their labels.

topologyKey.description: Node label key that defines the domain.

matchLabelKeys.description: Pod label keys whose values are combined with `labelSelector`, with the `In` operator.

mismatchLabelKeys.description: Pod label keys whose values are combined with `labelSelector`, with the `NotIn` operator.
